ex.en: We were all greatly amused by his jokes.
ex.zh: 他的笑話把我們都逗得很開心。

ex.en: His story amused everyone.
ex.zh: 他的故事把大家都逗笑了。

ex.en: We were all amused with the comedy.
ex.zh: 這齣喜劇讓我們都看得很開心。

amuse.en: to make someone laugh or smile

ex.en: The kids amused themselves with board games.
ex.zh: 孩子們玩桌遊打發時間。

ex.en: I amused myself by reading magazines at the airport.
ex.zh: 我在機場看雜誌打發時間。

amuse.en: to keep yourself busy and happy by doing something enjoyable

ex.en: She is an ambitious young manager.
ex.zh: 她是一位很有企圖心的年輕經理。

ex.en: Tom is ambitious and works very hard.
ex.zh: 湯姆很有抱負，工作也很努力。

ambitious.en: having a strong wish to be successful or powerful

ex.en: That's a very ambitious goal for one year.
ex.zh: 一年內要達成，這個目標很遠大。

ex.en: The company has an ambitious plan to expand into Asia.
ex.zh: 公司有一項進軍亞洲的宏大計畫。

ambitious.en: big and difficult and needing a lot of effort

ex.en: We have ample time to catch our train.
ex.zh: 我們有充裕的時間趕上火車。

ex.en: He has ample experience.
ex.zh: 他經驗豐富。

ex.en: There is ample parking near the hotel.
ex.zh: 飯店附近有充足的停車位。

amenity.zh: 便利設施（常用複數 amenities）

ex.en: The hotel offers amenities such as a gym and a pool.
ex.zh: 這家飯店提供健身房和游泳池等設施。

ex.en: The apartment is close to shops and other local amenities.
ex.zh: 這間公寓離商店和其他生活機能都很近。

amenity.en: a useful or pleasant feature of a place

ex.en: I was still an amateur at that time.
ex.zh: 我那時候還是個外行。

ex.en: My uncle is an amateur cricket player.
ex.zh: 我舅舅是業餘板球選手。

ex.en: This photo was taken by an amateur.
ex.zh: 這張照片是業餘攝影者拍的。

amateur.en: a person who does something for fun and not as a job

ex.en: He was appointed ambassador to Britain.
ex.zh: 他被任命為駐英大使。

ex.en: I have spoken with the Polish ambassador.
ex.zh: 我和波蘭大使談過了。

ambassador.en: an official who represents his or her country in a foreign country

ex.en: The actress is the brand's new ambassador.
ex.zh: 這位女演員是這個品牌的新代言人。

ex.en: The company hired a famous athlete as its ambassador.
ex.zh: 公司請了一位知名運動員擔任品牌大使。

ambassador.en: a person who is chosen to promote a brand or group

ex.en: He has ambition, so he works hard.
ex.zh: 他有抱負，所以很努力工作。

ex.en: Mary wanted to marry a man with ambition.
ex.zh: 瑪麗想嫁給一個有抱負的男人。

ex.en: He was a man of great ambition.
ex.zh: 他是個雄心勃勃的人。

ambition.en: a strong wish to be successful or powerful

ex.en: I am not without my shortcomings, but these shortcomings can easily be amended.
ex.zh: 我不是沒有缺點，但這些缺點很容易改正。

ex.en: We need to amend the contract.
ex.zh: 我們需要修改合約。

ex.en: The law was amended last year.
ex.zh: 這條法律去年修訂了。

amend.en: to change a text or law to make it better

ex.en: It's never too late to make amends.
ex.zh: 彌補永遠不嫌晚。

ex.en: He tried to make amends for his mistake.
ex.zh: 他試著彌補自己的錯誤。

amend.en: to do something to show you are sorry for a wrong you did

ex.en: The loan has a 20-year amortization period.
ex.zh: 這筆貸款的分期償還期為二十年。

ex.en: Amortization spreads the cost over several years.
ex.zh: 攤銷是把成本分攤到好幾年。

amortization.en: the paying off of a debt or cost in small parts over time

ex.en: The cost of the equipment is amortized over five years.
ex.zh: 設備成本分五年攤銷。

ex.en: We amortize the loan with monthly payments.
ex.zh: 我們每月分期償還這筆貸款。

amortize.en: to pay off a debt or cost in small parts over time

ex.en: Compiling a dictionary demands an enormous amount of time.
ex.zh: 編字典需要耗費大量時間。

ex.en: He would be paid a small amount of money.
ex.zh: 他會拿到一小筆錢。

ex.en: Please enter the amount you want to transfer.
ex.zh: 請輸入您要轉帳的金額。

amount.en: how much of something there is

ex.en: The bill amounted to 100 dollars.
ex.zh: 帳單總計一百美元。

ex.en: The loss amounts to a million dollars.
ex.zh: 損失高達一百萬美元。

amount.en: to add up to a total

ex.en: He amazed everyone by passing his driving test.
ex.zh: 他通過了駕照考試，讓大家都很驚訝。

ex.en: His memory amazes me.
ex.zh: 他的記憶力讓我很驚訝。

ex.en: We're amazed by the rapid growth in import quantities.
ex.zh: 進口量的快速成長讓我們很驚訝。

ex.en: This week has been an amazing experience.
ex.zh: 這週的經歷真的太棒了。

ex.en: The view from the top is amazing.
ex.zh: 從山頂看出去的景色太美了。

ex.en: The contract requires an amendment before we sign it.
ex.zh: 合約在簽署前需要修訂。

ex.en: Parliament passed an amendment to the tax law.
ex.zh: 國會通過了稅法修正案。

ex.en: Please send me the amendments by Friday.
ex.zh: 請在星期五前把修改的部分寄給我。

amendment.en: a change made to a law or document

amino.zh: 胺基的（常用 amino acid 胺基酸）

ex.en: Proteins are made of amino acids.
ex.zh: 蛋白質由胺基酸組成。

ex.en: Eggs contain all the essential amino acids.
ex.zh: 雞蛋含有所有必需胺基酸。

amino.en: of a nitrogen-containing chemical group found in the basic units of proteins

ex.en: Scientists measured the amplitude of the sound wave.
ex.zh: 科學家測量了聲波的振幅。

ex.en: Higher amplitude means a louder sound.
ex.zh: 振幅越大，聲音越大。

amplitude.en: the size of a wave or movement from its middle point

ex.en: The speakers amplify the singer's voice.
ex.zh: 喇叭放大了歌手的聲音。

ex.en: We used a microphone to amplify the speech.
ex.zh: 我們用麥克風擴大演講的音量。

ex.en: Social media can amplify a small mistake.
ex.zh: 社群媒體可能會把一個小錯誤放大。

ex.en: Could you amplify your point with an example?
ex.zh: 你能舉個例子進一步說明你的論點嗎？

amplify.en: to make an effect stronger or bigger

ex.en: I feel ambivalent about moving to a new city.
ex.zh: 對於搬到新城市，我的心情很矛盾。

ex.en: She was ambivalent about the job offer.
ex.zh: 對於這份工作邀約，她拿不定主意。

ex.en: The law is full of ambiguities.
ex.zh: 這條法律有很多模稜兩可的地方。

ex.en: To avoid ambiguity, please write the date clearly.
ex.zh: 為了避免含糊不清，請把日期寫清楚。

ambiguity.en: the quality of having more than one possible meaning

ex.en: Soft lighting gives the restaurant a relaxed ambience.
ex.zh: 柔和燈光讓餐廳氣氛十分放鬆。

ex.en: The hotel"s quiet ambience suits guests seeking a retreat.
ex.zh: 這間飯店安靜的氛圍很適合想放鬆休息的客人。

ambience.en: the mood or feeling of a place

ex.en: The hotel has excellent amenities, including a gym and a pool.
ex.zh: 這家飯店設施很好，有健身房和游泳池。

ex.en: The apartment is close to local amenities like shops and parks.
ex.zh: 這間公寓靠近商店、公園等生活機能。

amenities.en: useful or pleasant features of a place

ex.en: Call an ambulance.
ex.zh: 叫救護車。

ex.en: The ambulances carried the injured to the nearest hospital.
ex.zh: 救護車把傷者送往了最近的醫院。

ex.en: Hang on. The ambulance will get here in just a little bit.
ex.zh: 撐著點，救護車馬上就到。

ambulance.en: a vehicle that takes sick or hurt people to hospital

ex.en: The view from the mountain was amazing.
ex.zh: 從山上看出去的景色令人驚嘆。

ex.en: She has an amazing voice.
ex.zh: 她的歌聲好棒。

ex.en: It is amazing how fast children learn.
ex.zh: 小孩學得這麼快真是令人驚奇。

ex.en: She stood calmly amid the noise of the crowd.
ex.zh: 她在嘈雜的人群中靜靜站著。

ex.en: The team won amid cheers from thousands of fans.
ex.zh: 球隊在數千名球迷的歡呼聲中獲勝。

ex.en: My neighbor is an American who teaches English.
ex.zh: 我的鄰居是一位教英文的美國人。

ex.en: Many Americans enjoy watching baseball in summer.
ex.zh: 很多美國人夏天喜歡看棒球。

ex.en: She bought an American car last year.
ex.zh: 她去年買了一輛美國製的車。

ex.en: I like American movies, especially comedies.
ex.zh: 我喜歡美國電影，尤其是喜劇片。

ex.en: She was standing among a group of tourists.
ex.zh: 她站在一群觀光客當中。

ex.en: Pizza is very popular among teenagers.
ex.zh: 披薩在青少年之間非常受歡迎。

ex.en: The house was hidden among tall trees.
ex.zh: 那棟房子藏在高大的樹木之間。

ex.en: North America includes Canada, the United States and Mexico.
ex.zh: 北美洲包括加拿大、美國和墨西哥。

ex.en: Her uncle moved to America many years ago.
ex.zh: 她的叔叔多年前搬到了美國。

ex.en: Many people in America enjoy watching baseball.
ex.zh: 美國有很多人喜歡看棒球。

am.zh: 是（be 的第一人稱單數現在式，用於 I am）

ex.en: I am a student at a high school in Hsinchu.
ex.zh: 我是新竹一所高中的學生。

ex.en: I am very happy to see you again.
ex.zh: 再次見到你我非常開心。

ex.en: Sorry, I am not ready yet.
ex.zh: 抱歉，我還沒準備好。

ex.en: She felt happy amongst her old friends.
ex.zh: 在老朋友之間，她覺得很快樂。

ex.en: There was a small cat hiding amongst the boxes.
ex.zh: 有一隻小貓躲在那些箱子之中。

ex.en: Amongst all the gifts, this one was my favorite.
ex.zh: 在所有禮物之中，這個是我最喜歡的。

ex.en: She watched the cat chase its tail with amusement.
ex.zh: 她覺得貓追著自己尾巴跑的樣子很好笑，看得津津有味。

ex.en: To our amusement, the dog tried to climb into the box.
ex.zh: 讓我們覺得好笑的是，那隻狗竟然想爬進箱子裡。

ex.en: The town has an amusement park with a Ferris wheel.
ex.zh: 這個小鎮有一座附摩天輪的遊樂園。

ex.en: Reading was his main amusement during the long winter.
ex.zh: 漫長的冬天裡，閱讀是他主要的消遣。

ex.en: The government announced an amnesty for people who had broken the minor tax rules.
ex.zh: 政府宣布，對違反輕微稅務規定的人實施赦免。

ex.en: The library offered an amnesty, so overdue books could be returned without a fine.
ex.zh: 圖書館推出寬免期，逾期的書可以免罰款歸還。

ex.en: I was amazed by how quickly she learned the song.
ex.zh: 她學歌學得那麼快，讓我很驚訝。

ex.en: They were amazed to see snow in the desert.
ex.zh: 他們看到沙漠裡下雪時十分驚訝。

ex.en: Amsterdam is the capital of the Netherlands.
ex.zh: 阿姆斯特丹是荷蘭的首都。

ex.en: Many people ride bicycles along the canals of Amsterdam.
ex.zh: 許多人沿著阿姆斯特丹的運河騎腳踏車。

ex.en: We took a train from Paris to Amsterdam.
ex.zh: 我們從巴黎搭火車到阿姆斯特丹。

ex.en: Several languages are spoken across the Americas.
ex.zh: 整個美洲通行好幾種語言。

ex.en: The Americas include both North and South America.
ex.zh: 美洲包括北美洲和南美洲。

ex.en: The device draws two amps of current.
ex.zh: 這個裝置會用掉兩安培的電流。

ex.en: A ten-amp fuse protects the circuit from overload.
ex.zh: 十安培的保險絲能保護電路不會過載。

ex.en: He told us an amusing story about his trip.
ex.zh: 他跟我們說了一個關於他旅行的有趣故事。

ex.en: I found the movie more amusing than I expected.
ex.zh: 我覺得這部電影比我預期的還要好笑。

ex.en: His answer was ambiguous, so we weren't sure what he meant.
ex.zh: 他的回答模稜兩可，我們不確定他的意思。

ex.en: The ambiguous sign confused many drivers.
ex.zh: 那個意思不明的標誌讓許多駕駛人搞不清楚。

ex.en: She was amused by the little boy's joke.
ex.zh: 她被那個小男孩的笑話逗樂了。

ex.en: He gave an amused smile and shook his head.
ex.zh: 他露出覺得好笑的微笑，搖了搖頭。

ex.en: Amy is a short, popular name for girls.
ex.zh: Amy 是個簡短又常見的女孩名字。

ex.en: Amy sent me a message this morning.
ex.zh: 艾米今天早上傳了訊息給我。

ex.en: The soldiers ran out of ammunition.
ex.zh: 士兵們彈藥用盡了。

ex.en: The police stored the ammunition in a locked room.
ex.zh: 警方把彈藥存放在上鎖的房間裡。

ex.en: She stood calmly amidst the noise and confusion.
ex.zh: 她在吵鬧和混亂之中保持鎮定。

ex.en: The small house sat amidst tall trees.
ex.zh: 那間小屋坐落在高大的樹木之中。

ex.en: Amidst all the worry, they found a reason to laugh.
ex.zh: 在一片憂慮之中，他們找到了笑的理由。

ex.en: The children watched the magic show in amazement.
ex.zh: 孩子們驚奇地看著魔術表演。

ex.en: To my amazement, she remembered my name.
ex.zh: 令我驚訝的是，她記得我的名字。

ex.en: He shook his head in amazement.
ex.zh: 他驚訝得直搖頭。

ex.en: Amazingly, nobody was hurt in the accident.
ex.zh: 令人驚訝的是，這場意外中沒有人受傷。

ex.en: The little boy played the piano amazingly well.
ex.zh: 那個小男孩的鋼琴彈得好得驚人。

ex.en: She sensed that something was amiss when nobody answered the door.
ex.zh: 沒人應門時，她感覺事情不太對勁。

ex.en: Nothing seemed amiss at first glance.
ex.zh: 乍看之下似乎一切正常。

ex.en: Everything went amiss on the day of the big presentation.
ex.zh: 大簡報那天什麼都不順利。

ex.en: Her words fell amiss and made the room go quiet.
ex.zh: 她的話說得不得體，讓整個房間安靜下來。

ex.en: He plugged his guitar into a loud amplifier.
ex.zh: 他把吉他接上聲音很大的擴大機。

ex.en: The amplifier makes the weak signal stronger.
ex.zh: 放大器能讓微弱的訊號變強。

ex.en: She amassed a large collection of old coins.
ex.zh: 她累積了大量的古錢幣收藏。

ex.en: He amassed a fortune by selling used cars.
ex.zh: 他靠賣二手車累積了一筆財富。

ex.en: She felt ambivalence about moving abroad.
ex.zh: 她對搬到國外感到心情矛盾。

ex.en: His ambivalence toward the job made it hard to decide.
ex.zh: 他對那份工作的矛盾心態讓他很難做決定。
